name: Community — MOSS-Image Figure Finetunes
author: iamddtla / neuroshaman / J1B / CrHasher (pack: michaeldune)
description: Four mature MOSS-Image finetunes from Civitai that avoid the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards make on figure work. Two fast ones: Jib Mix Moss Realistic, a natural amateur-photo look in 12 steps, about 13 seconds on a 12 GB card; Artius Moss, a smoother, retouched look in 8 steps, about 15 seconds. Two slower ones: Anatomy Fix Moss, the base model's look and faces with the anatomy corrected, 50 steps, about 50 seconds; Prime Lust Moss, the most direct of the four, with a glamour look, 25 steps, about 37 seconds. They share the MOSS-Image text encoder and autoencoder, so each card adds only its own 5-7 GB checkpoint if you already have the MOSS-Image pack. Needs a SimpliGen engine with MOSS-Image support, which today means the beta engine (Settings > Updates > beta).

presets.name: Anatomy Fix Moss
presets.description: iamddtla's mature MOSS merge: MOSS-Image with LoRAs merged in to fix anatomy and add poses, while keeping the base model's look and faces. In our test it avoided the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards made. SFW prompts come out close to MOSS-Image, lettering included (quote every word you want on the picture). 50 steps as the author runs it, about 50 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card; 25-30 steps is about twice as fast. Character LoRAs work with it (the author tested them).

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3008033 (PornMaster Moss by iamddtla), version 3413227 'V1', file pornmasterMoss_v1.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW. Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit. The author's pinned comment: a merge of LoRAs from their Krea 2 training set to fix anatomy and add poses; 50 steps, example pictures at 25-30. No CFG or sampler given: CFG 2.5, er_sde / simple are the MOSS-Image defaults. Measured ~49 s per picture at 50 steps, ~28 s at 25. Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB: SFW, against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts at seed 11; NSFW by Michael against the MOSS-Image cards, where both finetunes avoided the anatomy errors (body horror) the base cards made.

presets.name: Artius Moss
presets.description: neuroshaman's Artius Moss: a fast MOSS-Image finetune, 8 steps at CFG 1, about 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. In our test it avoided the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards made on mature prompts. The look is smooth and retouched, and on SFW prompts it follows directions less closely than MOSS-Image and can add made-up small text; keep the words you want in quotes and check small print.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3010191 (Artius Moss by neuroshaman), version 3416029 'v1.0', file artiusMoss_v10.safetensors (int8, 6.98 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW. No commercial-use flags on Civitai (personal use). Author: 8 steps, CFG 1; no sampler given, euler / sgm_uniform as for the other 8-step MOSS models. Measured ~15 s per picture. SFW test: very close to Moss Image Turbo (same family), smooth skin, invented small text on one poster. Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB: SFW, against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts at seed 11; NSFW by Michael against the MOSS-Image cards, where both finetunes avoided the anatomy errors (body horror) the base cards made.

presets.name: Jib Mix Moss Realistic
presets.tagline: Fast photos with a natural, amateur look
presets.description: J1B's Jib Mix Moss Realistic V2: MOSS-Image with an 8-step speed LoRA merged in, tuned for an amateur-photo look with natural skin and lived-in rooms. 12 steps at CFG 1, about 13 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card, the fastest card in the pack. In our test it drew the sharpest anatomy; on some sex positions it drew a different pose, so name the position in the first sentence. Write the prompt as sentences, not a tag list.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3016339 (Jib Mix Moss Realistic by J1B), version 3435334 'V2 - Reality Renew', file jibMixMossRealistic_v2RealityRenew.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW. Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit, Rent. The 8-step speed LoRA is merged in. Author: 12 steps for V2 (4-9 for V1), CFG 1, er_sde / bong_tangent; bong_tangent is not a core ComfyUI scheduler, so beta. Measured ~13 s per picture in the app at 1024x1024 (~8 s engine-direct with the model already loaded). Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-28 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB: engine-direct on six mature prompts at seeds 11 and 42 against PornMaster and Artius (most natural skin, sharpest anatomy; on missionary both seeds drew the couple sitting face to face), and by Michael through the app on his own prompts against the other three cards.

presets.name: Prime Lust Moss
presets.tagline: MOSS-Image with a glossy glamour look
presets.description: CrHasher's Prime Lust MOSS: a MOSS-Image finetune made for explicit mature work, with a glossy, tanned glamour look. 25 steps at CFG 3.5, about 37 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. In our test its sex scenes were the most explicit and the easiest to read; check close-up anatomy on complex positions. The author notes a lean toward Asian faces, so describe the look you want.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 2793689 (Prime Lust by CrHasher), version 3425008 'MOSS SFT v1.0 (max-nsfw)', file primeLust_mossSFTV10MaxNsfw_int8.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW. Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit, Rent. Author's MOSS settings: 20+ steps, CFG 3.5+, exp_heun_2_x0_sde, sgm_uniform. exp_heun_2_x0_sde evaluates the model twice per step, so 25 steps cost about 50 model calls. Measured ~37 s per picture in the app at 1024x1024 (~31 s engine-direct with the model already loaded). Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-28 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB: engine-direct on six mature prompts at seeds 11 and 42 against PornMaster and Artius (most explicit; one missionary seed placed the anatomy wrong), and by Michael through the app on his own prompts against the other three cards.
